scope: Focused independent delta re-review solely of unsafe-recovery-order: Installer.apply exception/recovery block and three added regression tests. Other audit scope is referenced from the unchanged prior rejected report, not re-audited or newly approved here.

prior_review.relationship: Preserved unchanged. Its other audit checks remain the reference for their original scope; this repair review closes only its sole blocker for the exact installer/test artifacts recorded here.

findings: Recovery stop failure records stop:<exception> and leaves errors nonempty; restoration, pre-restart validation and recovery restart are all skipped. Terminal rollback_failed receipt is preserved.
Restoration errors are collected and suppress recovery restart. Existing restored files are hash/mode checked; absent baseline destinations are removed.

Before recovery restart, every baseline app/unit record is matched for exact hash/mode, every originally absent destination is checked absent, and complete protected baseline inventory is validated. Any validation failure records pre_restart:<exception> and suppresses restart.

Only successful quiescence, restoration and full pre-restart verification reach recovery restart. Baseline bytes/modes, inventory and baseline runtime selectors/health are rechecked after restart. SystemHooks.restart performs daemon-reload before restart; a reload exception prevents its restart command.

new_test_review.name: test_failed_recovery_stop_never_restores_or_restarts
new_test_review.assessment: Injects rollback stop failure after candidate restart failure; asserts no speech.py restoration, only initial restart attempt, candidate bytes untouched, and rollback_failed.

new_test_review.name: test_failed_restoration_never_restarts_candidate_source
new_test_review.assessment: Persistently fails speech.py restoration; restart source-byte log contains only the original candidate restart and receipt is rollback_failed.

new_test_review.name: test_baseline_inventory_is_verified_before_recovery_restart
new_test_review.assessment: Introduces unreviewed source during restoration; baseline speech.py is restored but inventory validation blocks recovery restart, with only initial restart attempt and rollback_failed.

artifact_stability: Installer, test source and prior rejected report SHA256 and modes matched before and after both test runs and immediately before report creation.
